title: Unlock English Fluency
hook: Five days, 30 hours, and a lot of talking. My signature course, for a big step forward in one week.
metaTitle: Unlock English Fluency | 5-Day Online English Intensive
metaDescription: A five-day online English fluency sprint with Dr Christina Grey: 30 hours of live speaking practice in a small group of 6 to 12 (B2+). £495, including a 45-minute 1-to-1 consultation.
whoFor: You understand most of what you hear, but when it's your turn to speak, you rehearse the sentence in your head until someone else has said it. This week is for upper-intermediate and advanced learners (B2 and above) who are ready to say it first.
practise: Speaking spontaneously on a new theme each day, such as culture, AI, work-life balance, or money
Linking your ideas with ‘bridges’: ready-made phrases for agreeing, disagreeing, and buying time to think
Listening to a TED talk or podcast, or reading an article, then explaining it to someone who didn't hear it
Role-plays for real situations, using a simple way to acknowledge, respond, and close a conversation
Small talk, debating, and giving your opinion with confidence

session.text: A look at the day ahead, then an icebreaker or a game to get everyone talking, coffee optional.

You talk about the day's theme in pairs, in breakout rooms, with the day's bridges to hand. Cambridge has plenty of bridges, but none of them has saved as many conversations as ‘That's a fair point, but…’. No punt required.
After a short break, you practise the chat before a meeting starts or over coffee, in pairs. The British have had centuries of practice, and now it's your turn.
Each team gets one piece of the day's theme (e.g. a TED talk or a podcast), and you put the picture together by explaining your piece to the other team. Like a jigsaw, but nobody has to do the sky.
After lunch, you act out real situations from work and everyday life in pairs, with a simple way to acknowledge, respond, and close a conversation.

We finish with a debate or a presentation in two teams. Each team prepares its case and takes the floor, and the other team is ready with tough questions. It's all very friendly, until someone mentions the prizes.

included: A 45-minute 1-to-1 video consultation with me after the course
Daily handouts with vocabulary and phrases

testimonial.text: The week with you was totally different! I felt much more confident speaking English after just a few days. I was really surprised how comfortable I was speaking English by day 5.
testimonial.name: Hannah
